salvage_bench.name: Salvage Bench
salvage_bench.description: A work surface assembled from recovered materials. Everything starts here.
salvage_bench.cultural_unlock: Physical artifacts can be documented. Glean works on paper-based finds.

hand_tools.name: Hand Tools
hand_tools.description: Salvaged and jury-rigged cutting, prying, and measuring tools. The difference between looking at something and being able to open it.

rain_collector.name: Rain Collector
rain_collector.description: Guttering, barrels, and a filter bed. Reliable water means reliable time in the workshop.

basic_greenhouse.name: Basic Greenhouse
basic_greenhouse.description: Salvaged glass panels over a timber frame. Extends the growing season and keeps the community fed through longer expeditions.

simple_shelving.name: Simple Shelving
simple_shelving.description: Proper storage for recovered materials. Nothing archaeological happens on a cluttered floor.

fabrication_table.name: Fabrication Table
fabrication_table.description: A heavier workbench with a vise, measured guides, and salvaged metalworking tools. The step between fixing things and making things.
fabrication_table.cultural_unlock: First Caches become readable. Personal device data, family photos, voice messages.

raft.name: Raft
raft.description: Lashed timber and salvaged foam, enough to navigate standing water. The Flooded District has been unreachable since the levees failed.

solar_panel_array.name: Solar Panel Array
solar_panel_array.description: Recovered photovoltaic cells rewired into a reliable array. Sustainable power for the Rig means the work doesn't stop when scavenged fuel runs out.

workshop_upgrade.name: Workshop Upgrade
workshop_upgrade.description: Better ventilation, insulation, and power routing. The Rig runs longer between rest cycles — processing time reduced by 25%.

medical_post.name: Medical Post
medical_post.description: A dedicated treatment space, co-designed with Petra. Neither of you could have built this alone — she knew what was needed; you knew how to build what wasn't there.

hardware_bench.name: Hardware Bench
hardware_bench.description: A clean workspace for circuit-level work, built with Eli. He knew which salvage to keep; you built the frame around it. Required to read the first Caches.

electronics_lab.name: Electronics Lab
electronics_lab.description: A dedicated space for working with salvaged electronics — oscilloscope, soldering station, component library. Built with Eli. Understanding what we lost means understanding how it worked.
electronics_lab.cultural_unlock: Digital archives, communication records, code repositories, first war-era Echoes.

cross_verification_rig.name: Cross-Verification Rig
cross_verification_rig.description: A second processing line patched into the Rig's existing infrastructure. Two Tools can now run simultaneously — cross-referencing outputs rather than waiting on each.

hardened_storage.name: Hardened Storage
hardened_storage.description: Redundant backup infrastructure for the Tools — surge-protected drives, climate-isolated enclosure. If something goes wrong, the work survives.

bioscanner.name: Bioscanner
bioscanner.description: A salvaged environmental analysis unit, restored with Petra's guidance. She can now analyze biological samples recovered from ruins — what was growing there, what changed.

archive_terminal.name: Archive Terminal
archive_terminal.description: Specialized hardware for reading degraded and obsolete storage formats. Older media becomes legible — yield probability penalties for aged formats are reduced.

community_hall.name: Community Hall
community_hall.description: A shared gathering space built for Ashford. The catalogue has always been for them — this is the first structure that makes that tangible.

broadcast_tower_stage_1.name: Broadcast Tower — Antenna Array
broadcast_tower_stage_1.description: The antenna framework: masts, cable runs, directional elements. It can't transmit yet. But it's up, and the shape of it changes how the village looks from the hill.
broadcast_tower_stage_1.cultural_unlock: The ability to transmit. This is the last thing you build.

broadcast_tower_stage_2.name: Broadcast Tower — Power System
broadcast_tower_stage_2.description: Dedicated power conversion and conditioning for the tower — enough stable current to drive a transmission signal. The antenna now has something to work with.

broadcast_tower_stage_3.name: Broadcast Tower — Encoding Station
broadcast_tower_stage_3.description: The final piece: a signal encoding unit that translates the Catalogue into something that can travel. How you encode it is still a question. Text, data, or both.

catalogue_formatting.name: Catalogue Formatting
catalogue_formatting.description: The question of how to send it. Text is readable by anyone with eyes. Data is recoverable by anyone with the right tools. Both assumes both will survive. The answer is yours.

signal_amplifier.name: Signal Amplifier
signal_amplifier.description: Optional. Extends transmission range. Whether anyone is out there to receive it is a different question — but the signal will travel farther if it needs to.
